metricDefinitions.name: constraint-evaluations
metricDefinitions.description: Number of constraint measurements, including the repeated measurements of candidate checks that repair candidates; they do not use the evaluation budget.

metricDefinitions.name: evaluations.real
metricDefinitions.description: Number of evaluations of the real optimisation function.

metricDefinitions.name: evaluations.surrogate
metricDefinitions.description: Number of predictions of a surrogate model.

metricDefinitions.name: sigma
metricDefinitions.description: The step size sigma of the distribution of CMA-ES.

metricDefinitions.name: axis-ratio
metricDefinitions.description: The ratio of the longest to the shortest principal axis of the covariance matrix C.

metricDefinitions.name: population-size
metricDefinitions.description: The population size lambda of CMA-ES.

metricDefinitions.name: restart
metricDefinitions.description: The number of the CMA-ES run of the distribution, 0 before the first restart.

metricDefinitions.name: mean-x:0
metricDefinitions.description: The mean of 'x:0' in the distribution of CMA-ES, mapped into the bounds.

metricDefinitions.name: mean-x:1
metricDefinitions.description: The mean of 'x:1' in the distribution of CMA-ES, mapped into the bounds.

metricDefinitions.name: mean-x:2
metricDefinitions.description: The mean of 'x:2' in the distribution of CMA-ES, mapped into the bounds.

metricDefinitions.name: mean-x:3
metricDefinitions.description: The mean of 'x:3' in the distribution of CMA-ES, mapped into the bounds.

propertyDefinitions.name: violation-1
propertyDefinitions.description: Degree of violation of the constraint 1 of the group 'budget': data 'x:0' + data 'x:1' >= 1.0 (0 if satisfied).

propertyDefinitions.name: attempts
propertyDefinitions.description: The number of variations of a candidate that a candidate check resampled, or the number of attempts of the repair of a repaired candidate.

propertyDefinitions.name: attempts
propertyDefinitions.description: Like the property of the relationship, for a candidate without predecessor.

propertyDefinitions.name: genotype
propertyDefinitions.description: The point of the distribution of CMA-ES that the bounds transformed into the candidate; set only if it differs from the candidate.

propertyDefinitions.name: restart
propertyDefinitions.description: The number of the CMA-ES run whose distribution sampled the candidate, 0 before the first restart.
